items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 4 named call sites (_triage_bundle.py:_build_detail, triage_bundle_render.py:build_detail, artifact_sync.py:_emit_drift_to_triage, security_triage_emit.py:emit_findings_to_triage) now self-cap detail before append_triage_item_idempotent; no other behavior changed.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Existing best-effort try/except Exception wrappers at each site are untouched; the fix removes the ValueError trigger rather than changing how errors are caught.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input reaches SQL/HTML; detail text is diagnostic (filenames, finding names, scanner descriptions) written to a local triage.jsonl file, matching the existing pattern at all 4 sites. No secrets introduced.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 10 new tests across 3 files assert on outcomes (item appended, detail length <= cap, no exception raised, ordinary input untouched) not internals; each site has an over-cap case and an under-cap case.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No new loops; the fix bounds output size, if anything reducing memory/IO for pathological inputs.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: _DETAIL_MAX_LEN naming matches security_card.py's established convention. artifact_sync.py was already at the 300-line cap; the fix was written net-zero-LOC (removed a decorative divider comment, folded truncation into the existing slice) so it stays at exactly 300.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No new serialized format or producer/consumer pair introduced -- this bounds an existing string field (detail) before handoff to the already-covered append_triage_item_idempotent boundary. The write-then-read round trip through triage.jsonl is exercised directly by the new tests via read_all_items.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: uv run shared/scripts/tools/scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings.
